findings.detail: No external dependencies; only database queries with connection pool timeout
Username uniqueness check prevents duplicate creation; retrying with same name returns 422

endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: Database unavailability returns 500; transaction ensures atomicity

findings.detail: Filesystem rename happens before transaction commit. If commit fails, code attempts rollback of filesystem rename, but if rollback also fails, state is inconsistent (filesystem renamed but DB not updated).
findings.recommendation: Add monitoring/alerting for the double-failure case; consider performing filesystem rename after commit

findings.detail: If new_name == current name, returns 204 immediately (no-op). Uniqueness check prevents conflicts.

non_atomic_operations: Filesystem rename + DB transaction commit are not atomic; partial failure can leave inconsistent state
endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: Filesystem failure after DB changes could leave org in broken state

findings.detail: Email update and other field updates are two separate DB operations (not in a transaction). If second fails, email is already updated.
findings.recommendation: Wrap both updates in a single transaction or combine into one UPDATE

non_atomic_operations: Email update and field update are separate non-transactional operations
endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: Partial update possible if second UPDATE fails

findings.detail: Filesystem and storage cleanup happen after transaction commit. If they fail, DB records are already deleted but files remain orphaned.
findings.recommendation: Add periodic cleanup job for orphaned files; acceptable since deletion is rare

non_atomic_operations: DB deletion committed before filesystem/storage cleanup; orphaned files possible on cleanup failure
endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: Storage failure leaves orphaned files but org is functionally deleted

health_checks.recommendation: Add dedicated readiness endpoint that checks DB connectivity

graceful_shutdown.detail: Uses modules/graceful package with ShutdownContext for background operations

rate_limiting.detail: No built-in rate limiting on API endpoints
rate_limiting.recommendation: Add rate limiting middleware or use reverse proxy rate limiting

dead_letter_queues.detail: No async message queues used by these endpoints

single_points_of_failure: Database (single connection, no read replicas configured by default)
